pages.text: Enderface and Niard are optional experiments. On the Create World screen, open Data Packs and enable the built-in Ender IO pack for the feature before creating the world. A Farming Station works in a default world.

On a dedicated server, add the matching built-in pack to initial-enabled-packs before world creation. Both IDs start with mod/enderio:data/enderio/datapacks/ and end in enderface or niard. Enable only the experiments you want.

In an Enderface-enabled world, the creative block labeled Ender IO is the preview point. Place it near the storage you want to access. Aim a charged Staff of Travelling at it and use the staff to open the preview.
Rotate or zoom the preview to see a target such as a chest or tank. Use the target inside the preview to open its normal menu. It must be within reach of the Enderface and have a clear path.
